pkgmetadata.longdescription: Storage and disk utility for the COSMIC desktop, written in Rust. Manages disks and partitions through UDisks2 (privileged operations go through Polkit), with BTRFS subvolume and snapshot management and rclone network mounts.

use.flag: When building in release or debug mode, only add line tables instead of full debug info.
Build with the maximum-optimization release profile (codegen-units=1).
